# PR4/5 — controls/inspection + CLI/Gateway

## Context capsule

This PR is item 4 of the rebuilt beta3 durable core stack. It exposes the wake inspection/control surface after the PR3 wake/replay foundation reached reviewer threshold.

## Durable core stack overview

- PR1/5 — docs/RFC/boundary anchor.
- PR2/5 — runtime foundation/core plus terminal SQLite row immutability guard.
- PR3/5 — wake targets, durable producers, replay/resume semantics.
- PR4/5 — controls/inspection plus CLI/Gateway surface.
- PR5/5 — internal session delivery handoff, final hardening, and cumulative proof.

## Stack position

- Stack item: PR4/5
- Current PR summary: Wake inspection/control store APIs, durable CLI commands, Gateway protocol/server methods and tests.
- Does not claim: No internal delivery/startup/worker handoff and no external transport delivery claim.
- Dependency/base: PR3 head `4f774fd5cc3cfc9b18c19ea891dd1358db80c8c9` (`openclaw/openclaw#105660`)
- This PR head: `bacf5c96acd2972eaad83f4d01d297dea57b06f5`
- Intended GitHub base: `release/2026.7.1`

## Dependency / promotion gate

- Submit gate: PR3 ClawSweeper threshold met before promotion.
- Verified PR3 gate: `openclaw/openclaw#105660` is OPEN, head `4f774fd5cc3cfc9b18c19ea891dd1358db80c8c9`, mergeStateStatus `CLEAN`, latest ClawSweeper review says Overall diamond lobster / Proof diamond lobster / Patch quality diamond lobster, with maintainer decision only.
- Ancestry: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4f774fd5cc3cfc9b18c19ea891dd1358db80c8c9 HEAD` passed.
- Next dependent PR: PR5 depends on this PR.

## What Problem This Solves

PR3 persists durable wake obligations and delivery attempts, but operators still need a bounded way to inspect, acknowledge, supersede, and mark those wake records. This slice adds that control surface in the durable store, CLI, and Gateway protocol without claiming delivery transport behavior.

## Scope

- Durable wake inspection/control store APIs for acknowledge, supersede, mark decision-required, inspect wakes, and list delivery attempts.
- Durable CLI commands: `wakes`, `wake`, `wake-attempts`, `wake-ack`, `wake-supersede`, and `wake-mark`.
- Gateway protocol schemas/validators and server methods for durable wake inspection/control.
- Focused tests for store, CLI, Gateway server methods, and Gateway protocol shape.

## Non-scope

- No `src/durable/wake-internal-delivery.ts`.
- No durable worker/internal session delivery handoff.
- No external transport delivery claim.
- No plugin SDK DTS fix.

## Base / diff hygiene

- Base comparison: `4f774fd5cc3cfc9b18c19ea891dd1358db80c8c9..bacf5c96acd2972eaad83f4d01d297dea57b06f5`
- Diff stat: 17 files changed, 3052 insertions, 18 deletions.
- Diff hygiene: `git diff --check 4f774fd5cc3cfc9b18c19ea891dd1358db80c8c9..HEAD` passed.
- Duplicate search: live `gh pr list` searches for the PR4 branch/head found no existing PR4 PR before creation.
- Conflict/replay notes: replayed the single PR4 controls commit onto final PR3 head; resolved conflicts by preserving PR3 atomic finalization/claim-fencing semantics and layering PR4 controls on top. After hosted `checks-fast-bundled-protocol` exposed generated Swift protocol drift, regenerated and included `apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawProtocol/GatewayModels.swift`.

## Proof matrix

| Gate | Command / artifact | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Focused behavior | `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/durable/wake-controls-inspection.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts src/commands/durable.test.ts packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.test.ts src/durable/wake-delivery-replay.test.ts src/durable/wake-producers.test.ts src/durable/wake-target-resolver.test.ts` | passed: 3 shards, 8 files, 105 tests |
| Typecheck | `pnpm tsgo:core` | passed |
| Test typecheck | `pnpm check:test-types` | passed before final type-only amend; rerun after amend blocked locally by ENOSPC |
| Store architecture | `node scripts/check-kysely-guardrails.mjs` | passed |
| Bundled/protocol CI lane | `pnpm test:bundled`; `pnpm protocol:check` | passed |
| CLI smoke | `pnpm openclaw durable --help` | passed; help lists wake inspection/control commands |
| Diff hygiene | `git diff --check 4f774fd5cc3cfc9b18c19ea891dd1358db80c8c9..HEAD` | passed |
| Stack ancestry | `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4f774fd5cc3cfc9b18c19ea891dd1358db80c8c9 HEAD` | passed |

## Live proof

- Environment: disposable exact-head local Gateway launched with `OPENCLAW_DURABLE_RUNTIME=1`, loopback token auth, isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, and no mutation to the installed OpenClaw service.
- Exact head: `bacf5c96acd2972eaad83f4d01d297dea57b06f5`.
- Running Gateway proof artifact: `/Users/avo/aicos/runtime/openclaw-durable-pr-stack/pr4-durable-gateway-live-proof-bacf5c96acd2.json`.
  - Authorized WebSocket `connect` with `operator.read` + `operator.write`: passed.
  - `durable.wake.list`, `durable.wake.inspect`, and `durable.wake.deliveryAttempts.list` against seeded persisted wake state: passed.
  - `durable.wake.acknowledge`: persisted `wake_gateway_ack` from `pending` to `acked`: passed.
  - `durable.wake.supersede`: persisted `wake_gateway_supersede` from `pending` to `superseded`: passed.
  - `durable.wake.mark`: persisted `wake_gateway_mark` as `pending` with `requires_human_decision` wake-control metadata: passed.
- Terminal/idempotency proof artifact: `/Users/avo/aicos/runtime/openclaw-durable-pr-stack/pr4-durable-gateway-terminal-proof-bacf5c96acd2.json`.
  - Repeated `durable.wake.acknowledge` with the same idempotency key returned the existing `acked` wake: passed.
  - Invalid `durable.wake.supersede` against the terminal `acked` wake returned `INVALID_REQUEST` and left persisted state unchanged: passed.
- Not run: installed OpenClaw service restart or external transport proof. This PR intentionally does not claim external delivery or internal handoff behavior; PR5 owns the internal session delivery handoff proof.

## ClawSweeper requirements

- Includes authored `What Problem This Solves` section: yes.
- Includes authored `Evidence`/proof content: yes.
- Names stored data model / migration impact when schema or persisted state changes: yes; PR4 adds control operations over the PR3 wake records and no new tables.
- Names risk labels ClawSweeper should evaluate: compatibility, session-state, message-delivery, durable-runtime, diff-hygiene.
- Keeps proof artifacts accessible in body or durable stack state.

## Risk / upgrade notes

- Runtime risk: incorrect controls could acknowledge or supersede the wrong wake; tests cover wake IDs, attempt IDs, metadata decisions, and Gateway/CLI validation.
- Compatibility/upgrade risk: no new table is introduced here, but this PR depends on PR3's wake tables and PR2's durable store foundation.
- Rollback/feature-flag posture: durable runtime remains opt-in; stack rollback should follow PR boundaries.

## Evidence

- Final head: `bacf5c96acd2972eaad83f4d01d297dea57b06f5`
- PR3 base head: `4f774fd5cc3cfc9b18c19ea891dd1358db80c8c9`
- Focused Vitest: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.test.ts src/durable/wake-controls-inspection.test.ts` passed, 4 files, 72 tests across the unit + gateway shards.
- `pnpm docs:list`: passed.
- `pnpm check:docs`: passed.
- `pnpm protocol:check`: passed.
- Exact-head running Gateway proof: passed; see artifacts named in Live proof.
- `pnpm build`: produced the runtime files needed for Gateway proof, then failed at `check-plugin-sdk-exports` because plugin SDK declarations were `5034698` bytes over the `5000000` byte limit and one required plugin-sdk artifact was reported missing. This PR did not touch plugin SDK files.
- Fork/private parity: `mjnkao/openclaw` and `mjnkao/openclaw-x` PR4 branches both point to `bacf5c96acd2972eaad83f4d01d297dea57b06f5`.

## Next gate

Review PR4 on top of PR3. Do not promote PR5 until this PR reaches the configured reviewer threshold.
